title: 第一卷 第15章 相兽，天蛇！
lines: 李伟松了口气，有了这块满相籍的令牌，返程路上便能省去不少麻烦。
另一边，陈渊与陈昭宁打探到王家府邸坐落于城北郊外，当即快步疾驰而去。
“镇级地域虽无真正的法体境强者，但对方人手定然不少，哪怕皆是灵窍境，凭我们二人恐怕也难以抗衡……”
一路疾驰，陈昭宁侧首对着身旁的陈渊沉声开口。
陈渊环顾四周，见沿途街道人烟愈发稀少，心知目的地定然十分偏僻。
“得找些爆发力更强的武器。”
陈渊低声自语，伸手摸了摸腰间的铁刺。
“什么？”
陈昭宁没有听清他的话语。
蓦地，前方一片竹林映入眼帘。
“借你的刀一用。”
陈渊在竹林前驻足，忽然开口道。
陈昭宁没有迟疑，立刻将佩刀递了过去。
陈渊挥刀砍下一根根青竹，又将竹梢一头削得尖锐锋利。
“你这是在做什么？”
陈昭宁满心疑惑。
“缚龙搏杀术中有一式，名为断筋爪。”
陈渊一边忙活，随口念出断筋爪的口诀，
“爪出裂筋络，气走玄黄纲。”
“近身无完骨，残躯坠寒江。”
闻言，陈昭宁目光骤然一凝，但还是不明白对方要做什么，不由得开口，“你什么意思？”
“我已是灵窍境大圆满，近乎触及法体境门槛，肉身气力远超常人。
我可以试着，将这近身搏杀之术，化作远攻之法，借势爆发大规模的杀伤力。”
陈渊一边修整竹竿，一边缓缓解释。
她难以想象，灵窍境大圆满的修士，究竟能爆发出何等恐怖战力。
灵窍数量越多，修炼速度便越快，所能储存的灵力也越发浑厚。
寻常修士能开启百处灵窍，便已是妖孽天资。
可陈渊，足足三百六十一处灵窍……念及此处，陈昭宁深吸一口气，心中满是期待。
不多时，陈渊整理出十几根一米多长的竹竿，用身上破旧棉袄裹好，捆绑在一起，背在身后。
“不知道我这灵窍数量，在这片地域算什么水准？应该还算合格吧？”
收拾妥当，陈渊看向愣神呆滞的陈昭宁，好奇问道。
陈昭宁又是一声长叹，一时竟不知该如何言语。
她简直想骂人。
何止是合格？
根本就是逆天妖孽！
你不过修炼一年左右，便开了周身所有灵窍！
那我苦修十年，才堪堪开启九十处灵窍，又算什么？
是废物？
还是废物都不如？
content_zh:
糯米听到这话，如闻恶鬼低吟，顿时打了个哆嗦，浑身颤抖起来。

    她强忍着哭声，眼泪却还是止不住地流下。

    四周之人神色冷漠，仿佛在看一件平常事。

    柳晴看着自己宝贝儿子的所作所为，并未阻止，只是看向身旁的护卫，问道：

    “可打探清楚了？这丫头的背后，可有什么背景？”

    不等那护卫开口，王成便笑道：

    “放心吧娘，她是成衣铺老板卖给我的。

    更何况，就算她有背景，那又如何？”

    “在整个山岗镇的各个村落，哪个村长或是大户，敢不听我爹的？”

    “不过一个人族罢了，即便有众生籍，也只是低贱的平民，玩死了又何妨？”

    说着，王成满脸倨傲，神色满是不在意。

    “说的也是。”

    柳晴点了点头。

    眼前这丫头皮肤细腻，不似那些吃不饱、病恹恹的奴隶，

    她方才不过是怕这丫头背后有强大家族撑腰，才随口一问，心里倒也没太在意。

    在山岗镇，她丈夫便是天。

    更何况，她背后怀山县的家族，也是一个有三百年底蕴的小世家，势力着实不弱。

    “行了，我们回去吧，你爹还在等着我们吃晚饭呢。”

    柳晴看向王成，语气宠溺地开口。

    一行几十人的车队再次动了起来，朝着王家府邸的方向驶去。

    “娘，我先走一步！这小丫头太有趣了，我迫不及待要回去玩她了！”

    王成说着，调转马头，嗷嗷大叫着，马蹄疾驰，转瞬便跑出了二十多米。

    “小心点，别那么粗鲁，别把自己弄疼了……”柳晴脸上露出宠溺的笑意，见王成已经听不到自己的声音，才无奈地笑道：“这孩子……”

    可下一瞬，她的瞳孔猛地收缩！

    “不好！成儿，小心！”

    她当即嘶声大叫起来！

    嗖——————

    几乎是同时，一声仿佛空气被刺破的爆裂声回荡天地间！

    前方骑马狂奔的少年，脑袋一侧突然被一根竹竿狠狠贯穿！

    噗！

    那竹竿带起一大片血花，强大的力量将少年整个人掀飞，狠狠钉死在路边的大树干上！

    砰！！！

    大树剧烈震颤，哗啦啦的树皮纷飞，伴随着无数树叶簌簌落下。

    而少年王成的脑袋已被彻底贯穿，死死钉在树干上！

    他双目圆睁，嘴巴大张！

    脸上还残留着先前那股，兴奋到变态的笑容。

    这般突如其来的变故，让柳晴双瞳骤缩！

    刹那间，眼珠布满了无数触目惊心的血痕！

    “成……成儿！！”

    她凄厉地嘶叫着，身躯因愤怒与悲痛而剧烈哆嗦！

    “护住夫人！”

    其余人脸色骤变，当即持刀分散开来，警惕地环顾四周。

    还有人跃到旁边的树干上，形成错落的制高点。

    看着王成脑袋被贯穿、早已没了气息的模样，柳晴只觉得天旋地转，眼前阵阵发黑！

    “谁？到底是谁！！敢杀我儿，我要将他千刀万剐！！！”

    柳晴嘶吼着，面目因愤怒而扭曲，如同厉鬼一般，狰狞至极！

    咻——

    咻——

    咻——

    就在这时，又有三根竹竿从山林中朝着大道激射而来！

    速度极快，几乎化作了青色的残影！

    噗！

    噗！

    噗———
content_en:
When Nuomi heard this, she trembled as if she heard the whisper of an evil ghost, and her whole body started to tremble.

She suppressed her crying, but her tears still flowed uncontrollably.

The people around him looked indifferent, as if they were watching an ordinary thing.

Liu Qing looked at what her precious son was doing and did not stop him. She just looked at the guard beside her and asked:

"Have you found out? What's the background behind this girl?"

Before the guard could speak, Wang Cheng smiled and said:

"Don't worry, mother, she was sold to me by the owner of the clothing store.

What's more, even if she has a background, so what?"

"In all the villages in Shanggang Town, which village chief or big family member dares not to listen to my father?"

"It's just a human race. Even if there are sentient beings, they are just lowly commoners. So what if they die?"

As he said this, Wang Cheng looked arrogant and indifferent.

"That's true."

Liu Qing nodded.

The girl in front of me has delicate skin, unlike those slaves who are underfed and sick.

She just asked casually because she was afraid that this girl had the support of a powerful family, but she didn't care too much.

In Shanggang Town, her husband is the sky.

What's more, the family in Huaishan County behind her is also a small aristocratic family with a history of three hundred years, and its power is really not weak.

"Okay, let's go back, your father is still waiting for us to have dinner."

Liu Qing looked at Wang Cheng and spoke in a doting tone.

A convoy of dozens of people started moving again, heading towards the Wang family's residence.

"Mom, let me go first! This little girl is so interesting, I can't wait to go back and play with her!"

Wang Cheng said, turning the horse's head, howling and shouting, the horse's hooves galloped, and ran more than 20 meters in an instant.

"Be careful, don't be so rude, don't hurt yourself..." A doting smile appeared on Liu Qing's face. Seeing that Wang Cheng could no longer hear her voice, she smiled helplessly: "This child..."

But the next moment, her pupils shrank suddenly!

"No! Cheng'er, be careful!"

She immediately screamed!

Whoosh——————

Almost at the same time, a crackling sound as if the air was being pierced echoed across the world!

The young man running wildly on horseback in front of him was suddenly penetrated by a bamboo pole on the side of his head!

puff!

The bamboo pole brought up a large amount of blood flowers, and the powerful force lifted the young man's whole body away, and nailed him to the big tree trunk on the roadside!

Bang!!!

The big tree trembled violently, bark flew, and countless leaves fell.

And young Wang Cheng’s head has been completely penetrated and nailed to the tree trunk!

His eyes were wide open and his mouth was open!

The smile that was so exciting and perverted from before still remains on his face.

Such a sudden change made Liu Qing's pupils shrink suddenly!

In an instant, his eyes were covered with countless shocking blood stains!

"Cheng...Cheng'er!!"

She screamed miserably, her body trembling violently with anger and grief!

"Protect Madam!"

The expressions of the others changed suddenly, and they immediately spread out with knives, looking around cautiously.

Some people jumped to the tree trunks nearby, forming a scattered commanding height.

Seeing Wang Cheng's head being penetrated and his breath already gone, Liu Qing felt like the world was spinning and her eyes were going dark!

"Who? Who is it?! If you dare to kill my son, I will cut him into pieces!!!"

Liu Qing roared, her face twisted with anger, like a ghost, extremely ferocious!

Phew——

Phew——

Phew——

At this moment, three more bamboo poles shot out from the forest toward the avenue!

The speed was so fast that it almost turned into a cyan afterimage!

puff!

puff!

puff---
